verses.1:1: And it happened after the death of Moses that the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, the assistant of Moses, saying,
verses.1:2: "Moses My servant has died. Now then, rise up and cross the Jordan, you and all this people, into the land which I am giving to them.
verses.1:3: Every place on which you step with the sole of your feet, I will give it to you, just as I have spoken to Moses:
verses.1:4: the wilderness and the Anti-Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, and as far as the farthest sea; your borders shall be from the setting of the sun.
verses.1:5: No man shall stand opposed before you all the days of your life; and just as I was with Moses, so I will also be with you, and I will not abandon you nor overlook you.
verses.1:6: Be strong and courageous; for you shall apportion to this people the land which I swore to your fathers to give to them.
verses.1:7: Be strong therefore and courageous to be careful and to do according to what Moses My servant commanded you, and you shall not turn aside from them to the right or to the left, so that you may understand in all things that you do.
verses.1:8: And the book of this law shall not depart from your mouth, and you shall meditate in it day and night, so that you may know how to do all the things that have been written; then you will be prospered, and it will prosper your ways, and then you will understand.
verses.1:9: Look, I have commanded you: be strong and courageous; do not be timid nor be afraid, because the Lord your God is with you in all things, wherever you go."
verses.1:10: And Joshua commanded the scribes of the people, saying,
verses.1:11: "Enter into the middle of the camp of the people, and command the people, saying, 'Prepare provisions for yourselves, because in three more days you are crossing this Jordan, entering to take possession of the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, is giving to you.'"
verses.1:12: And to Reuben and to Gad and to the half of the tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
verses.1:13: "Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, 'The Lord your God has given you rest and has given you this land.'
verses.1:14: Your wives and your little children and your livestock shall dwell in the land which He gave you; but you shall cross over armed ahead of your brothers, everyone who is strong, and you shall fight alongside them,
verses.1:15: until the Lord our God gives rest to your brothers just as also to you, and they too inherit the land which the Lord our God is giving to them; and you shall depart, each one to his inheritance, which Moses has given you across the Jordan toward the rising of the sun."
verses.1:16: And answering Joshua, they said, "All things that you command us we will do, and to every place where you send us we will go.
verses.1:17: According to all things in which we listened to Moses, we will listen to you; only may the Lord our God be with you just as He was with Moses.
verses.1:18: And the man who disobeys you, and whoever does not listen to your words according to whatever you command him, let him die. But be strong and courageous."
verses.2:1: And Joshua son of Nun sent out two young men from Shittim to spy, saying, "Go up and see the land and Jericho." And the two young men went and entered into Jericho, and they entered into the house of a woman who was a prostitute, whose name was Rahab, and they lodged there.
verses.2:2: And it was reported to the king of Jericho, saying, "Men of the sons of Israel have come in here to spy out the land."
verses.2:3: And the king of Jericho sent and spoke to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who have entered into your house tonight; for they have come to spy out the land."
verses.2:4: And the woman took the two men and hid them, and she spoke to them, saying, "The men have come in to me;
verses.2:5: but as the gate was being shut in the dark, the men went out. I do not know where they have gone; pursue after them, to see if you will overtake them."
verses.2:6: Now she had brought them up onto the roof and hidden them in the stalks of flax that had been stacked by her on the roof.
verses.2:7: And the men pursued after them along the road to the Jordan, to the fords, and the gate was shut.
verses.2:8: And it happened, when those pursuing after them had gone out, and before they themselves lay down to sleep, she went up onto the roof to them
verses.2:9: and said to them, "I know that the Lord has given you the land, for the fear of you has fallen upon us.
verses.2:10: For we have heard that the Lord God dried up the Red Sea from before you when you were coming out from the land of Egypt, and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who were across the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
verses.2:11: And when we heard, we were dismayed in our heart, and no spirit stood any longer in any one of us before you; because the Lord your God is He who is in heaven above and on the earth below.
verses.2:12: And now swear to me by the Lord God; because I am showing mercy to you, you also show mercy in the house of my father.
verses.2:13: And keep alive the house of my father, my mother and my brothers and all my house and all that belongs to them, and you shall deliver my life from death."
verses.2:14: And the men said to her, "Our life in place of yours to death." And she said, "When the Lord hands over the city to you, you shall show mercy and truth to me."
verses.2:15: And she let them down through the window;
verses.2:16: and she said to them, "Go away into the hill country, so that the pursuers do not meet you, and hide yourselves there three days until those pursuing after you return, and after this you shall depart on your way."
verses.2:17: And the men said to her, "We are guiltless regarding this oath of yours:
verses.2:18: Look, we are entering into a part of the city, and you shall set the sign: you shall tie this scarlet cord onto the window through which you let us down, and you shall gather your father and your mother and your brothers and all the house of your father to yourself into your house.
verses.2:19: And it shall be that everyone who goes outside the door of your house will be liable for himself, while we are guiltless regarding this oath of yours; and for as many as are with you in your house, we will be liable.
verses.2:20: But if anyone wrongs us or even reveals these words of ours, we will be guiltless regarding this oath of yours."
verses.2:21: And she said to them, "According to your word let it be." And she sent them away.
verses.2:22: And they went and came into the hill country, and they remained there three days; and the pursuers searched out all the roads and did not find them.
verses.2:23: And the two young men returned and came down from the mountain, and crossed over to Joshua son of Nun, and recounted to him all the things that had happened to them.
verses.2:24: And they said to Joshua, "The Lord has handed over all the land into our hand, and everyone dwelling in that land has cowered before us."
verses.3:1: And Joshua rose early in the morning and set out from Shittim; and they came as far as the Jordan, and they lodged there before crossing over.
verses.3:2: And it happened after three days that the scribes passed through the camp
verses.3:3: and commanded the people, saying, "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord our God, and our priests and the Levites carrying it, you shall set out from your places and go after it.
verses.3:4: However, let there be a distance between us and it; you shall stand about two thousand cubits away; do not approach it, so that you may know the way that you are going; for you have not gone the way from yesterday and the third day."
verses.3:5: And Joshua said to the people, "Purify yourselves for tomorrow, because tomorrow the Lord will do wondrous things among us."
verses.3:6: And Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and go ahead of the people." And the priests took up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and went in front of the people.
verses.3:7: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, "On this day I begin to exalt you before all the sons of Israel, so that they may know: just as I was with Moses, so I will also be with you.
verses.3:8: And now command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant, saying, 'As soon as you enter into the middle of the water of the Jordan, then in the Jordan you shall stand.'"
verses.3:9: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "Draw near here and listen to the word of the Lord our God.
verses.3:10: By this you shall know that a living God is among you, and He will surely destroy from before us the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Amorite and the Girgashite and the Jebusite.
verses.3:11: Look, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is crossing the Jordan.
verses.3:12: Choose for yourselves twelve men from the sons of Israel, one from each tribe.
verses.3:13: And it shall be, as soon as the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth come to rest in the water of the Jordan, the water of the Jordan will fail, and the water coming down will stand."
verses.3:14: And the people set out from their tents to cross the Jordan, and the priests carried the ark of the covenant ahead of the people.
verses.3:15: And as the priests carrying the ark of the covenant were entering into the Jordan, and the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord were dipped into a part of the water of the Jordan (now the Jordan was full along its entire bank, as in days of wheat harvest),
verses.3:16: then the waters coming down from above stood; they stood as one solid mass, standing off very, exceedingly far, as far as a part of Kathiairein, while that which was coming down went down into the sea of Arabah, the Sea of Salt, until it failed completely; and the people stood opposite Jericho.
verses.3:17: And the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all the sons of Israel were crossing over through dry ground, until all the people finished crossing the Jordan.
verses.4:1: And when all the people had finished crossing the Jordan, the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.4:2: "Taking men from the people, one from each tribe,
verses.4:3: instruct them, 'Pick up twelve ready stones from the middle of the Jordan, and carrying these across along with you and them, place them in your encampment, wherever you camp there for the night.'"
verses.4:4: And Joshua, having summoned twelve of the distinguished men from the sons of Israel, one from each tribe,
verses.4:5: said to them, "Go forward in front of me, before the presence of the Lord, into the middle of the Jordan, and let each one pick up a stone from there and carry it on his shoulders according to the number of the twelve tribes of Israel,
verses.4:6: so that these may be for you a sign set in place continually; so that when your son asks you tomorrow, saying, 'What are these stones to us?'
verses.4:7: then you will explain to your son, saying, 'The Jordan River ceased before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth when it was crossing it.' And these stones will be a memorial for you, the sons of Israel, forever."
verses.4:8: And the sons of Israel did so, just as the Lord had commanded Joshua; and they took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, just as the Lord had instructed Joshua at the completion of the crossing of the sons of Israel, and carried them across with themselves into the camp and set them down there.
verses.4:9: Now Joshua also set up another twelve stones in the Jordan itself, in the place that had been under the feet of the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord; and they are there until this day.
verses.4:10: Now the priests who carried the ark of the covenant were standing in the Jordan until Joshua finished everything that the Lord had commanded to declare to the people; and the people hurried and crossed over.
verses.4:11: And it came about, when all the people had finished crossing, that the ark of the covenant of the Lord crossed over, and the stones in front of them.
verses.4:12: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and half the tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed in front of the sons of Israel, just as Moses had commanded them.
verses.4:13: Forty thousand ready for battle crossed over before the Lord to war, toward the city of Jericho.
verses.4:14: On that day the Lord exalted Joshua before the entire nation of Israel, and they feared him just as they did Moses, for as long as he lived.
verses.4:15: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.4:16: "Command the priests who carry the ark of the covenant of the testimony of the Lord to come out of the Jordan."
verses.4:17: And Joshua commanded the priests, saying, "Come out of the Jordan."
verses.4:18: And it came about, when the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord came out of the Jordan and placed their feet on the ground, that the water of the Jordan rushed back to its place and flowed just as yesterday and the day before over the entire bank.
verses.4:19: And the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth of the first month, and the sons of Israel encamped in Gilgal on the side toward the sunrise from Jericho.
verses.4:20: And these twelve stones, which he had taken from the Jordan, Joshua set up in Gilgal,
verses.4:21: saying, "When your sons ask you, saying, 'What are these stones?'
verses.4:22: declare to your sons, 'On dry land Israel crossed this Jordan,
verses.4:23: since the Lord our God dried up the water of the Jordan from before them until they crossed over, just as the Lord our God did to the Red Sea, which the Lord our God dried up before us until we passed through,
verses.4:24: so that all the nations of the earth may know that the power of the Lord is mighty, and so that you may worship the Lord our God in every work.'"
verses.5:1: And it came about, when the kings of the Amorites who were across the Jordan and the kings of Phoenicia who were by the sea heard that the Lord God had dried up the Jordan River from before the sons of Israel while they were crossing, that their minds melted and they were dismayed, and there was no understanding at all in them before the presence of the sons of Israel.
verses.5:2: Now about this time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make for yourself stone knives from sharp-edged rock, and sitting down, circumcise the sons of Israel."
verses.5:3: And Joshua made sharp-edged stone knives, and he circumcised the sons of Israel at the place called Hill of the Foreskins.
verses.5:4: Now as for the manner in which Joshua thoroughly cleansed the sons of Israel: all who were ever born on the way, and all who were ever uncircumcised among those who had come out of Egypt,
verses.5:5: all these Joshua circumcised; for forty-two years Israel had moved about in the desert of Madbaritis.
verses.5:6: Therefore, most of them, the fighting men who had come out of the land of Egypt, were uncircumcised, those who had disobeyed the commands of God, to whom He also decreed that they should not see the land which the Lord swore to our fathers to give, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.5:7: And in place of these He raised up their sons, whom Joshua circumcised because they had been born uncircumcised along the way.
verses.5:8: And having been circumcised, they remained still, staying right there in the camp until they were healed.
verses.5:9: And the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, "On this very day I have taken away the reproach of Egypt from you." And he called the name of that place Gilgal.
verses.5:10: And the sons of Israel kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month, from evening, to the west of Jericho, in the region across the Jordan, on the plain;
verses.5:11: and they ate from the grain of the land, unleavened bread and fresh grain.
verses.5:12: On this day the manna ceased after they had eaten from the grain of the land, and there was no longer manna for the sons of Israel; rather, they harvested the crop of the Phoenicians in that year.
verses.5:13: And it came about, while Joshua was at Jericho, that lifting up his eyes he saw a man standing opposite him, and his sword was drawn in his hand. And Joshua approached and said to him, "Are you ours, or one of the adversaries?"
verses.5:14: And he said to him, "I, commander of the army of the Lord, have now come." And Joshua fell on his face to the ground and said to him, "Master, what do you command your servant?"
verses.5:15: And the commander of the Lord said to Joshua, "Untie the sandal from your feet, for the place on which you are now standing is holy."
verses.6:1: Now Jericho was shut up and fortified, and no one was going out from it nor going in.
verses.6:2: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Look, I am delivering Jericho into your hand, and its king who is in it, who are mighty in strength.
verses.6:3: Now you, station the fighting men around it in a circle.
verses.6:5: And it will be, whenever you sound the trumpet, let all the people shout together; and when they shout, the walls of the city will fall of themselves, and all the people will enter, each one rushing straight ahead into the city."
verses.6:6: And Joshua the son of Nun went in to the priests
verses.6:7: and spoke to them, saying, "Order the people to go around and encircle the city, and let the fighting men march armed before the Lord;
verses.6:8: and let seven priests holding seven sacred trumpets pass along likewise before the Lord and sound the signal vigorously; and let the ark of the covenant of the Lord follow behind.
verses.6:9: And let the fighting men march in front, and the priests who form the rear guard behind the ark of the covenant of the Lord, sounding the trumpets."
verses.6:10: Now Joshua commanded the people, saying, "Do not shout, nor let anyone hear your voice, until the day he himself announces to shout out; and then you will shout out."
verses.6:11: And having gone around, the ark of the covenant of God immediately departed to the camp and lodged there.
verses.6:12: And on the second day Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the covenant of the Lord,
verses.6:13: and the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets were marching ahead before the Lord. And after these the fighting men were marching in, and the rest of the crowd behind the ark of the covenant of the Lord;
verses.6:14: and the priests sounded the trumpets, and all the rest of the crowd encircled the city from close by and departed again to the camp. So they did for six days.
verses.6:15: And on the seventh day they rose at dawn, and they went around the city six times;
verses.6:16: and on the seventh circuit the priests sounded the trumpets, and Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "Shout! For the Lord has delivered the city to you.
verses.6:17: And the city will be devoted to destruction, it and everything that is in it, to the Lord Sabaoth. Only keep Rahab the prostitute alive, her and everything that is in her house.
verses.6:18: But as for you, guard yourselves strictly from what is devoted to destruction, so that, desiring it, you yourselves do not take from what is devoted to destruction and make the camp of the sons of Israel devoted to destruction, and wipe us out.
verses.6:19: And all silver or gold or bronze or iron will be holy to the Lord; it will be brought into the treasury of the Lord."
verses.6:20: And the priests sounded the trumpets; and when the people heard the trumpets, all the people shouted together with a great and mighty shout. And the entire wall fell all around, and all the people went up into the city.
verses.6:21: And Joshua devoted it to destruction, and all that was in the city, from man even to woman, from young man even to old man, and even to calf and beast of burden, by the edge of the sword.
verses.6:22: And to the two young men who had spied, Joshua said, "Go into the house of the woman and bring her out from there and all that belongs to her."
verses.6:23: And the two young men who had spied out the city went into the house of the woman, and they brought out Rahab the prostitute and her father and her mother and her brothers and her relatives and everything that was hers, and they settled her outside the camp of Israel.
verses.6:24: And the city was burned with fire along with everything in it, except for silver and gold and bronze and iron; they gave them to be brought into the treasury of the Lord.
verses.6:25: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute and all her father's household alive, and she lived in Israel until this day, because she hid the spies whom Joshua had sent to spy out Jericho.
verses.6:26: And Joshua pronounced an oath on that day before the Lord, saying, "Cursed is the man who will build that city. At the cost of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates." And so did Ozan of Bethel: at the cost of Abiram the firstborn he laid its foundation, and at the cost of the youngest who survived he set up its gates.
verses.6:27: And the Lord was with Joshua, and his name was throughout all the land.
verses.7:1: And the sons of Israel committed a great offense and secretly took for themselves from the devoted thing; and Achar son of Carmi, son of Zambri, son of Zerah, from the tribe of Judah, took from the devoted thing; and the Lord was enraged with anger against the sons of Israel.
verses.7:2: And Joshua sent men to Ai, which is near Bethel, saying, "Scout out Ai."
verses.7:3: And the men went up and scouted out Ai, and returned to Joshua and said to him, "Do not let all the people go up, but let about two thousand or three thousand men go up and take the city by siege; do not bring all the people up there, for they are few."
verses.7:4: And about three thousand men went up, and they fled from before the men of Ai.
verses.7:5: And the men of Ai killed about thirty-six men from among them, and pursued them from the gate and crushed them from the slope; and the heart of the people was terrified and became like water.
verses.7:6: And Joshua tore his garments, and Joshua fell to the ground on his face before the Lord until evening, he and the elders of Israel, and they threw dust on their heads.
verses.7:7: And Joshua said, "I plead, Lord, why did Your servant bring this people across the Jordan, to hand them over to the Amorite to destroy us? And if only we had remained and settled beside the Jordan!
verses.7:8: And what shall I say, since Israel has turned its neck before its enemy?
verses.7:9: And when the Canaanite and all who inhabit the land hear, they will surround us and wipe us out from the earth; and what will You do with Your great name?"
verses.7:10: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Rise up! Why have you fallen like this on your face?
verses.7:11: The people have sinned and transgressed the covenant which I made with them; having stolen from the devoted thing, they put it into their belongings.
verses.7:12: The sons of Israel will by no means be able to stand firm before their enemies; they will turn their necks before their enemies, because they have become a devoted thing; I will no longer continue to be with you unless you remove the devoted thing from among yourselves.
verses.7:13: Rise up, consecrate the people, and tell them to consecrate themselves for tomorrow. This is what the Lord God of Israel says: 'The devoted thing is among you; you will not be able to stand up before your enemies until you remove the devoted thing from among you.
verses.7:14: And you shall all be gathered in the morning by tribes, and it shall be that the tribe which the Lord points out, you shall bring forward by clans; and the clan which the Lord points out, you shall bring forward by household; and the household which the Lord points out, you shall bring forward man by man.
verses.7:15: And whoever is pointed out shall be burned up with fire, and all that belongs to him, because he transgressed the covenant of the Lord and committed a lawless deed in Israel.'"
verses.7:16: And Joshua rose early and brought the people forward by tribes; and the tribe of Judah was pointed out.
verses.7:17: And it was brought forward by clans, and the Zerahite clan was pointed out; and it was brought forward man by man,
verses.7:18: and Achar son of Zambri, son of Zerah, was pointed out.
verses.7:19: And Joshua said to Achar, "Give glory today to the Lord God of Israel, and make confession, and tell me what you have done, and do not hide it from me."
verses.7:20: And Achar answered Joshua and said, "Truly I have sinned before the Lord God of Israel; I have acted in this way and that.
verses.7:21: I saw among the plunder a smooth multicolored cloak, and two hundred didrachmas of silver, and one golden tongue of fifty didrachmas, and desiring them, I took them; and look, they are hidden in my tent, and the silver is hidden underneath them."
verses.7:22: And Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent in the camp; and these things were hidden in the tent, and the silver was underneath them.
verses.7:23: And they brought them out of the tent and brought them to Joshua and the elders of Israel, and placed them before the Lord.
verses.7:24: And Joshua took Achar son of Zerah and brought him up to the Valley of Achor, and his sons and his daughters, and his calves and his pack animals and all his sheep, and his tent and all his possessions, and all the people were with him; and he brought them up to Emek-achor.
verses.7:25: And Joshua said to Achar, "Why have you destroyed us? May the Lord utterly destroy you, just as today."
verses.7:26: And all Israel stoned him with stones, and raised over him a great heap of stones; and the Lord ceased from the fury of His anger. Therefore he named it Emek-achor, until this day.
verses.8:1: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear nor lose heart; take with you all the men of war, and rise up and go up to Ai. Look, I have given into your hands the king of Ai and his land.
verses.8:2: And you shall do to Ai just as you did to Jericho and its king, and the plunder of the livestock you shall take as plunder for yourself. Now set for yourself an ambush behind the city."
verses.8:3: And Joshua rose up, and all the people of war, to go up to Ai. And Joshua chose thirty thousand men, mighty in strength, and sent them out by night.
verses.8:4: And he commanded them, saying, "You, lie in ambush behind the city; do not go far from the city, and you shall all be ready.
verses.8:5: And I and all those with me will approach the city, and it will be that when the inhabitants of Ai come out to meet us just as previously, then we will flee from before them.
verses.8:6: And when they come out after us, we will draw them away from the city; and they will say, 'These men are fleeing from before us just as before.'
verses.8:7: But you shall rise up from the ambush and go into the city.
verses.8:8: According to this word you shall act; look, I have commanded you."
verses.8:9: And Joshua sent them out, and they went to the ambush; and they sat in wait between Bethel and Ai, on the west of Ai.
verses.8:10: And rising early in the morning, Joshua mustered the people; and they and the elders went up before the people against Ai.
verses.8:11: And all the people of war with him went up, and marching on, they came opposite the city on the east,
verses.8:12: and the ambush of the city was on the west.
verses.8:14: And it happened that when the king of Ai saw it, he hurried and went out to meet them straight ahead to the battle, he and all the people who were with him; and he himself did not know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.
verses.8:15: And Joshua and Israel saw it and withdrew from before them.
verses.8:16: And they pursued after the sons of Israel, and they drew away from the city.
verses.8:17: No one was left in Ai who did not pursue after Israel; and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.
verses.8:18: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Stretch out your hand with the javelin that is in your hand toward the city, for into your hands I have handed it over; and the ambushers will rise up quickly from their place." And Joshua stretched out his hand, the javelin, toward the city.
verses.8:19: And the ambushers rose up quickly from their place and went out when he stretched out his hand, and came upon the city and captured it; and hurrying, they burned the city with fire.
verses.8:20: And the inhabitants of Ai looked around behind them and saw smoke going up from the city into the sky; and they no longer had anywhere to flee, this way or that.
verses.8:21: And Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambushers had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city had gone up into the sky; and turning around, they struck down the men of Ai.
verses.8:22: And these came out from the city to meet them, and they were in the middle of the army, some on this side and some on that side; and they struck them down until not a survivor or an escapee of them was left.
verses.8:23: And they captured the king of Ai alive, and brought him to Joshua.
verses.8:24: And when the sons of Israel finished killing all those in Ai, those in the plains and on the mountain at the descent where they had pursued them from it to the end, then Joshua returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
verses.8:25: And those who fell on that day, from man even to woman, were twelve thousand, all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.8:27: Except for the spoils that were in the city, all of which the sons of Israel took as plunder for themselves according to the command of the Lord, just as the Lord had ordered Joshua.
verses.8:28: And Joshua burned the city with fire; he made it an uninhabited mound forever, until this day.
verses.8:29: And he hanged the king of Ai on a forked tree, and he was on the tree until evening; and as the sun was setting, Joshua gave orders, and they took down his body from the tree and threw him into the pit, and raised over him a heap of stones, until this day.
verses.9:1: Now when the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan—those in the hill country and those in the lowland and those along the entire coast of the Great Sea and those near Anti-Lebanon—and the Hittites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites heard,
verses.9:2: they assembled in one place to make war against Joshua and Israel, all of them together. Then Joshua built an altar to the Lord, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the sons of Israel, as it is written in the law of Moses—an altar of whole stones upon which no iron had been laid; and he offered up burnt offerings there to the Lord, a sacrifice of deliverance. And Joshua wrote on the stones the second law, the law of Moses, in the presence of the sons of Israel. And all Israel, and their elders, and the judges, and their scribes were marching along on this side and on that side opposite the ark—and the priests and the Levites lifted up the ark of the covenant of the Lord—both the resident alien and the native-born, half of whom were near Mount Gerizim and half of whom were near Mount Ebal, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded to bless the people first. And after these things Joshua accordingly read all the words of this law, the blessings and the curses, according to everything written in the law of Moses. There was not a word from all that Moses had commanded Joshua which Joshua did not read in the ears of the entire assembly of the sons of Israel—to the men, the women, and the children, and to the resident aliens who joined Israel.
verses.9:3: And the inhabitants of Gibeon heard everything that the Lord had done to Jericho and to Ai.
verses.9:4: And they also acted with craftiness; going out, they gathered provisions and prepared themselves. And they took old sacks on their shoulders, and old wineskins that were torn and tied up;
verses.9:5: and the hollows of their shoes and their sandals were old and resoled on their feet, and their garments were worn out upon them, and the bread of their provisions was dry and moldy and eaten away.
verses.9:6: And they came to Joshua to the camp of Israel at Gilgal, and they said to Joshua and Israel, "We have come from a distant land; and now, make a covenant with us."
verses.9:7: And the sons of Israel said to the Horite, "See, perhaps you are living among me; and how could I make a covenant with you?"
verses.9:8: And they said to Joshua, "We are your servants." And Joshua said to them, "Where are you from, and from where have you come?"
verses.9:9: And they said, "From a very distant land your servants have come in the name of the Lord your God; for we have heard His name, and all that He did in Egypt,
verses.9:10: and all that He did to the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of the Amorites and to Og king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and in Edrei.
verses.9:11: And when they heard, our elders and all the inhabitants of our land spoke to us, saying, 'Take for yourselves provisions for the journey and go to meet them, and you shall say to them, "We are your servants; and now, make a covenant with us."'
verses.9:12: These loaves of bread—we took them warm as provisions on the day we went out to come to you, but now they have dried out and have become eaten away;
verses.9:13: and these wineskins that we filled new, these have torn; and our garments and our shoes have worn out from the very long journey."
verses.9:14: And the leaders took some of their provisions, and did not inquire of the Lord.
verses.9:15: And Joshua made peace with them, and they made a covenant with them to preserve them, and the leaders of the congregation swore to them.
verses.9:16: And it happened after three days, after making a covenant with them, that they heard that they were near them and that they were living among them.
verses.9:17: And the sons of Israel set out and came to their cities. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeron, and the cities of Jarin.
verses.9:18: And the sons of Israel did not fight against them, because all the leaders had sworn to them by the Lord, the God of Israel; and the entire congregation grumbled against the leaders.
verses.9:19: And the leaders said to the entire congregation, "We have sworn to them by the Lord, the God of Israel, and now we will not be able to touch them.
verses.9:20: This we will do: spare them alive, and we will preserve them, and there will be no wrath against us because of the oath that we swore to them.
verses.9:21: They will live, and they will be woodcutters and water carriers for the entire congregation"—just as the leaders said to them.
verses.9:22: And Joshua summoned them and said to them, "Why have you deceived me, saying, 'We are very far from you,' when you are locals, of those living among us?
verses.9:23: And now you are cursed; there will never be lacking from among you a servant or a woodcutter for me and for my God."
verses.9:24: And they answered Joshua, saying, "It was reported to us all that the Lord your God commanded Moses His servant, to give you this land and to utterly destroy us and all those living upon it from before you; and we were greatly afraid for our lives before you, and we did this thing.
verses.9:25: And now, look, we are under your hand; as it pleases you and as it seems right to you, do to us."
verses.9:26: And they did so to them; and Joshua rescued them on that day from the hands of the sons of Israel, and they did not kill them.
verses.9:27: And on that day Joshua appointed them woodcutters and water carriers for the entire congregation and for the altar of God. Therefore the inhabitants of Gibeon became woodcutters and water carriers of the altar of God to this day, and for the place that the Lord may choose.
verses.10:1: Now when Adoni-bezek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai and utterly destroyed it—just as they had done to Jericho and its king, so they had done to Ai and its king—and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had defected to Joshua and to Israel,
verses.10:2: they were greatly afraid of them; for he knew that Gibeon was a great city, like one of the mother cities, and all its men were strong.
verses.10:3: And Adoni-bezek king of Jerusalem sent to Elam king of Hebron, and to Phidon king of Jarmuth, and to Jephtha king of Lachish, and to Dabin king of Adullam, saying,
verses.10:4: "Come, come up to me and help me, and let us make war against Gibeon; for they have defected to Joshua and to the sons of Israel."
verses.10:5: And the five kings of the Jebusites went up—the king of Jerusalem, and the king of Hebron, and the king of Jarmuth, and the king of Lachish, and the king of Adullam—they and all their people, and they encamped around Gibeon and were besieging it.
verses.10:6: And the inhabitants of Gibeon sent to Joshua to the camp of Israel at Gilgal, saying, "Do not relax your hands from your servants; come up to us quickly and rescue us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites who live in the hill country have assembled against us."
verses.10:7: And Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the fighting people with him, everyone mighty in strength.
verses.10:8: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands; not one of them will be left before you."
verses.10:9: And when Joshua came upon them suddenly, he had marched in all night from Gilgal.
verses.10:10: And the Lord threw them into panic before the sons of Israel, and the Lord crushed them with a great crushing at Gibeon; and they pursued them along the road of the ascent of Horonin, and kept cutting them down as far as Azekah and as far as Makkedah.
verses.10:11: Now while they were fleeing from before the sons of Israel on the descent of Horonin, the Lord hurled hailstones upon them from heaven as far as Azekah; and those who died because of the hailstones were more than those whom the sons of Israel killed with the sword in the battle.
verses.10:12: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord on the day God delivered the Amorite under the hand of Israel, when He crushed them at Gibeon and they were crushed before the sons of Israel; and Joshua said, "Let the sun stand still opposite Gibeon, and the moon opposite the valley of Aijalon."
verses.10:13: And the sun and the moon stood at a standstill until God took vengeance on their enemies. And the sun stood in the middle of heaven; it did not advance toward setting until the end of one day.
verses.10:14: And there was no day like that, neither before nor afterward, that God listened to a man; for the Lord fought alongside Israel.
verses.10:16: And these five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.
verses.10:17: And it was reported to Joshua, saying, "The five kings have been found hidden in the cave at Makkedah."
verses.10:18: And Joshua said, "Roll stones against the mouth of the cave, and appoint men to keep watch over them;
verses.10:19: but you, do not stand still; keep pursuing after your enemies, and overtake their rear guard, and do not let them enter their cities; for the Lord our God has delivered them into our hands."
verses.10:20: And it happened, when Joshua and every son of Israel had finished cutting them down with a very great slaughter to the end, that those who were escaping escaped into the fortified cities.
verses.10:21: And all the people returned to Joshua at Makkedah unharmed, and not one of the sons of Israel muttered with his tongue.
verses.10:22: And Joshua said, "Open the cave, and bring these five kings out of the cave."
verses.10:23: And they brought the five kings out of the cave: the king of Jerusalem, and the king of Hebron, and the king of Jarmuth, and the king of Lachish, and the king of Adullam.
verses.10:24: And when they had brought them out to Joshua, Joshua summoned all Israel and the commanders of the war who went with him, saying to them, "Step forward and place your feet on their necks." And coming near, they placed their feet on their necks.
verses.10:25: And Joshua said to them, "Do not fear them nor be fainthearted; be courageous and be strong, for in this way the Lord will do to all your enemies against whom you fight."
verses.10:26: And Joshua killed them and hung them on five trees; and they were hanging on the trees until evening.
verses.10:27: And it happened toward sunset that Joshua gave a command, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave into which they had fled for refuge, and they rolled stones against the cave, to this day.
verses.10:28: And they captured Makkedah on that day, and they slaughtered it by the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed every breathing thing in it, and not one was left in it who survived and escaped; and they did to the king of Makkedah just as they had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.10:29: And Joshua went, and all Israel with him, from Makkedah to Libnah, and he laid siege to Libnah.
verses.10:30: And the Lord delivered it into the hands of Israel, and they captured it and its king, and he slaughtered it by the edge of the sword and every breathing thing in it, and no one was left in it who survived and escaped; and they did to its king just as they had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.10:31: And Joshua went, and all Israel with him, from Libnah to Lachish, and he encamped around it and laid siege to it.
verses.10:32: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel, and he captured it on the second day, and they slaughtered it by the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed it, just as they had done to Libnah.
verses.10:33: Then Helam king of Gaza went up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people down by the edge of the sword, until not one of them was left who survived and escaped.
verses.10:34: And Joshua went, and all Israel with him, from Lachish to Adullam, and he encamped around it and besieged it.
verses.10:35: And the Lord delivered it into the hand of Israel, and he captured it on that day, and he slaughtered it by the edge of the sword; and they slaughtered every breathing thing in it, just as they had done to Lachish.
verses.10:36: And Joshua went, and all Israel with him, to Hebron, and he encamped around it.
verses.10:37: And he struck it down by the edge of the sword, and every breathing thing—all that were in it; there was no one who survived. Just as they had done to Adullam, they utterly destroyed it and all that was in it.
verses.10:38: And Joshua and all Israel turned back to Debir, and having encamped around it,
verses.10:39: they captured it and its king and its villages, and they struck it down by the edge of the sword, and they utterly destroyed it and every breathing thing in it, and they did not leave in it a single one who survived. Just as they had done to Hebron and to its king, so they did to Debir and to its king.
verses.10:40: And Joshua struck down all the land of the hill country, and Nabai, and the lowland, and Asedoth, and its kings; they did not leave one of them who survived, and he utterly destroyed everything breathing life, just as the Lord, the God of Israel, had commanded.
verses.10:41: From Kadesh-barnea as far as Gaza, all of Goshen as far as Gibeon.
verses.10:42: And Joshua struck down all their kings and their land at one time, because the Lord, the God of Israel, was fighting alongside Israel.
verses.11:1: Now when Jabis king of Hazor heard, he sent to Jobab king of Marron, and to the king of Symoon, and to the king of Aziph,
verses.11:2: and to the kings who were near great Sidon, in the hill country, and in Raba opposite Chinneroth, and in the plain, and in Phenaeddor,
verses.11:3: and to the coastal Canaanites from the east, and to the coastal Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, and the Perizzites who were in the mountain, and the Hittites who were below the wilderness toward Maseuman.
verses.11:4: And they went out, they and their kings with them, like the sand of the sea in multitude, and very many horses and chariots.
verses.11:5: And all the kings themselves assembled and came to the same place, and they encamped at the water of Marron to fight against Israel.
verses.11:6: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid before them, for tomorrow at this hour I am handing them over routed before Israel; you shall hamstring their horses, and you shall burn up their chariots with fire."
verses.11:7: And Joshua and all the fighting people came upon them suddenly at the water of Marron, and fell upon them in the hill country.
verses.11:8: And the Lord handed them over into the hands of Israel, and striking them, they pursued them as far as great Sidon, and as far as Maseron, and as far as the plains of Massoch toward the east; and they cut them down until no survivor of them was left.
verses.11:9: And Joshua did to them just as the Lord commanded him: he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
verses.11:10: And Joshua turned back at that time and captured Hazor and its king; now Hazor was formerly ruler of all these kingdoms.
verses.11:11: And they killed everything that breathed in it with the sword and utterly destroyed all of them, and nothing that breathed was left in it; and they burned Hazor with fire.
verses.11:12: And Joshua took all the cities of the kings and their kings and struck them down with the edge of the sword, and they utterly destroyed them, just as Moses the servant of the Lord ordered.
verses.11:13: However, Israel did not burn any of the cities raised on mounds; only Hazor alone Israel burned.
verses.11:14: And the sons of Israel took all its spoil as plunder for themselves; but all of them they utterly destroyed with the edge of the sword until he destroyed them; they did not leave even one of them that breathed.
verses.11:15: Just as the Lord ordered Moses His servant, so likewise Moses commanded Joshua, and so Joshua did; he did not set aside anything of all that Moses ordered him.
verses.11:16: And Joshua took all the mountainous land, and all Adeb, and all the land of Goshen, and the lowland, and the land toward the west, and Mount Israel, and the low places
verses.11:17: that are by the mountain, from Mount Hachel, and what goes up to Seir, and as far as Baal-gad, and the plains of Lebanon below Mount Hermon; and all their kings he took and struck down and killed.
verses.11:18: And for many days Joshua made war against these kings.
verses.11:19: There was not a city that Israel did not take; they took everything in war,
verses.11:20: for it came about through the Lord that their heart grew strong to meet Israel in war, so that they might be utterly destroyed, so that mercy might not be given to them, but that they might be utterly destroyed, just as the Lord said to Moses.
verses.11:21: And Joshua came at that time and utterly destroyed the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron and from Debir and from Anaboth, and from all the race of Israel and from all the mountain of Judah, with their cities; and Joshua utterly destroyed them.
verses.11:22: None of the Anakim was left from the sons of Israel, but only in Gaza and in Aseldo were any left.
verses.11:23: And Joshua took all the land, just as the Lord commanded Moses; and Joshua gave them as an inheritance to Israel by division according to their tribes. And the land ceased from being warred against.
verses.12:1: And these are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel struck down and whose land they inherited beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the gorge of Arnon as far as Mount Hermon, and all the land of Arabah on the east:
verses.12:2: Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, exercising dominion from Arnon, which is in the gorge along part of the gorge, and half of Gilead as far as Jabbok, the borders of the sons of Ammon,
verses.12:3: and Arabah as far as the Sea of Chinnereth toward the east, and as far as the Sea of Arabah, the Sea of Salt, on the east, the way toward Hasimoth, from Teman, that which is below Medoth-pisgah;
verses.12:4: and Og king of Bashan remained from the giants, the one who lived in Ashtaroth and in Edrei,
verses.12:5: ruling from Mount Hermon and from Sekchai, and all Bashan as far as the borders of Gergesi and Machei, and half of Gilead, the borders of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.12:6: Moses the servant of the Lord and the sons of Israel struck them; and Moses gave it as an inheritance to Reuben and Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.12:7: And these are the kings of the Amorites whom Joshua and the sons of Israel struck down on the other side of the Jordan by the sea, Baal-gad in the plain of Lebanon and as far as Mount Chelcha as one goes up to Seir, and Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel to inherit according to their allotment,
verses.12:8: in the mountain, and in the plain, and in Arabah, and in Asedoth, and in the wilderness and the Negev, the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite;
verses.12:9: and the king of Jericho, and the king of Ai, which is near Bethel,
verses.12:10: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron,
verses.12:11: the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish,
verses.12:12: the king of Ailam, the king of Gezer,
verses.12:13: the king of Debir, the king of Asei,
verses.12:14: the king of Hermath, the king of Airath, the king of Arath,
verses.12:15: the king of Libnah, the king of Adullam,
verses.12:17: the king of Ataphout, the king of Hepher,
verses.12:18: the king of Aphek of Arok,
verses.12:20: the king of Symoon, the king of Mamroth, the king of Aziph,
verses.12:21: the king of Kedesh, the king of Zakach,
verses.12:22: the king of Maredoth, and the king of Jekom of Carmel,
verses.12:23: the king of Eldom of Phenneddor, the king of Geei of Galilee,
verses.12:24: the king of Tirzah; all these were twenty-nine kings.
verses.13:1: Now Joshua was old, advanced in days. And the Lord said to Joshua, "You are advanced in days, and much of the land remains for an inheritance.
verses.13:2: And this is the land that remains: the territory of the Philistines, the Geshurite, and the Canaanite;
verses.13:3: from the uninhabited land facing Egypt as far as the borders of Ekron on the left of the Canaanites, it is reckoned to the five satrapies of the Philistines: the Gazite, and the Ashdodite, and the Ashkelonite, and the Gittite, and the Ekronite, and the Hivite;
verses.13:4: from Teman and to all the land of Canaan opposite Gaza, and the Sidonians as far as Taphek, as far as the borders of the Amorites;
verses.13:5: and all the land of Galiath of the Philistines, and all Lebanon toward the rising of the sun, from Galgaa under Mount Hermon as far as the entrance of Hamath.
verses.13:6: Everyone who inhabits the hill country from Lebanon as far as Maserethmemphonmaim, all the Sidonians, I will utterly destroy them from before Israel; but distribute it as an allotment to Israel, just as I commanded you.
verses.13:7: And now divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe of Manasseh,
verses.13:8: from the Jordan as far as the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun you will give it; the Great Sea will form the border." To the tribes and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to Reuben and to Gad, Moses gave on the other side of the Jordan; toward the rising of the sun Moses the servant of the Lord had given to him,
verses.13:9: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the brook of Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the ravine, and all the Mishor from Daidaban;
verses.13:10: all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the borders of the sons of Ammon;
verses.13:11: and Gilead, and the territory of the Geshurite and of the Maacathite, all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Acha;
verses.13:12: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Edrei and in Ashtaroth; he was left from the giants, and Moses struck him down and utterly destroyed him.
verses.13:13: And the sons of Israel did not utterly destroy the Geshurite and the Maacathite and the Canaanite; and the king of the Geshurite and the Maacathite lived among the sons of Israel until this day.
verses.13:14: Only to the tribe of Levi was no inheritance given; the Lord, the God of Israel, He is their inheritance, as the Lord said to them. And this is the distribution that Moses distributed to the sons of Israel in Araboth of Moab, on the other side of the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.13:15: And Moses gave to the tribe of Reuben according to their clans.
verses.13:16: And their territory was from Aroer, which is facing the ravine of Arnon, and the city that is in the ravine of Arnon, and all the Mishor
verses.13:17: as far as Heshbon, and all the cities that are in the Mishor, and Dibon, and Baimon Baal, and the house of Meelboth,
verses.13:18: and Basan, and Bakedmoth, and Mephaath,
verses.13:19: and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Serada, and Seion on Mount Enab,
verses.13:20: and Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-thaseinoth,
verses.13:21: and all the cities of the Mishor, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, whom Moses struck down, him and the leaders of Midian, and Evi, and Robok, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba the ruler, the spoils of Sihon, and those who inhabited Sihon.
verses.13:22: And they killed Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, in the rout.
verses.13:23: And the borders of Reuben were the Jordan as a border. This is the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their clans, their cities and their settlements.
verses.13:24: Now Moses gave to the sons of Gad according to their clans.
verses.13:25: And their territory was Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half of the land of the sons of Ammon as far as Araba, which is facing Arad,
verses.13:26: and from Heshbon as far as Araboth opposite Mizpah, and Botanei, and Baan as far as the borders of Dibon,
verses.13:27: and Enadom, and Othargaei, and Bainthanabra, and Succoth, and Zaphon, and the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon; and the Jordan will form the border as far as a part of the Sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan on the east.
verses.13:28: This is the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their clans; they will turn the neck before their enemies, because it came to be according to their clans: their cities and their settlements.
verses.13:29: And Moses gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh according to their clans.
verses.13:30: And their territory was from Maana, and all the kingdom of Bashan, and all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair that are in Bashan, sixty cities;
verses.13:31: and half of Gilead, and in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, to those of Machir, sons of Manasseh, and to half of the sons of Machir, sons of Manasseh, according to their clans.
verses.13:32: These are those to whom Moses apportioned an inheritance beyond the Jordan in Araboth of Moab, on the other side of the Jordan opposite Jericho on the east.
verses.14:1: And these are those of the sons of Israel who received an inheritance in the land of Canaan, to whom Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the rulers of the ancestral houses of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned an inheritance.
verses.14:2: By lots they inherited, just as the Lord commanded by the hand of Joshua for the nine tribes and for the half-tribe,
verses.14:3: from the other side of the Jordan. And to the Levites he did not give an allotment among them,
verses.14:4: for the sons of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim; and no portion in the land was given to the Levites, except cities to live in, and their set-apart lands for the livestock, and their livestock.
verses.14:5: Just as the Lord commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.14:6: And the sons of Judah came to Joshua in Gilgal, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know the word that the Lord spoke to Moses, the man of God, concerning me and you in Kadesh Barnea.
verses.14:7: For I was forty years old when Moses the servant of God sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land, and I answered him with a word according to his mind.
verses.14:8: Yet my brothers who went up with me turned away the heart of the people, but I devoted myself to follow the Lord my God.
verses.14:9: And Moses swore on that day, saying, 'The land on which you stepped will be for you as an allotment and for your children forever, because you devoted yourself to follow after the Lord our God.'
verses.14:10: And now the Lord has sustained me, just as He said, this forty-fifth year since the Lord spoke this word to Moses, and Israel walked in the wilderness. And now, here I am today, eighty-five years old;
verses.14:11: I am still as strong today as when Moses sent me; in the same way I am strong now to go in and to go out to war.
verses.14:12: And now I ask you for this mountain, as the Lord said on that day; for you have heard this word on that day. And now the Anakim are there, fortified and great cities; therefore, if the Lord is with me, I will utterly destroy them, just as the Lord spoke to me."
verses.14:13: And Joshua blessed him, and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh, the son of Kenaz, as an allotment.
verses.14:14: Therefore Hebron came to belong to Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as an allotment until this day, because he followed the command of the Lord, God of Israel.
verses.14:15: Now the name of Hebron formerly was the city of Argob; this was the mother city of the Anakim. And the land rested from war.
verses.15:1: And the borders of the tribe of Judah according to their clans were from the borders of Judea, from the wilderness of Zin as far as Kadesh toward the south.
verses.15:2: And their borders on the south were as far as the edge of the Salt Sea, from the ridge that extends toward the south;
verses.15:3: and they pass across opposite the ascent of Akrabbim, and go out around Ennak, and go up on the south to Kadesh-barnea, and go out to Hezron, and ascend to Sarada, and go out along the west of Kadesh,
verses.15:4: and go out to Selmona, and will extend as far as the valley of Egypt, and the outlet of its borders will be at the sea; these are their borders on the south.
verses.15:5: And the borders on the east are all the Salt Sea as far as the Jordan. And their borders on the north, both from the ridge of the sea and from the edge of the Jordan,
verses.15:6: the borders go up to Beth-aglaam, and pass along on the north to Beth-arabah, and the borders ascend to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;
verses.15:7: and the borders ascend to the fourth part of the valley of Achor, and go down to Taagad, which is opposite the approach of Adummim, which is to the south of the valley, and will extend to the water of the spring of the sun, and its outlet will be the spring of Rogel;
verses.15:8: and the borders go up into the valley of Hinnom to the south of Jebus on the south (this is Jerusalem), and the borders run out to the top of a mountain which is facing the valley of Hinnom toward the sea, which is at the edge of the land of Rephaim on the north;
verses.15:9: and the border extends from the top of the mountain to the spring of the water of Maphtho, and extends to Mount Ephron, and the border will lead to Jebaal (this is the city of Jearim);
verses.15:10: and the border will turn around from Baal toward the sea, and will pass on to Mount Assar, at the back of the city of Jearim on the north (this is Chesalon), and will go down to the city of the sun, and will pass on toward the south;
verses.15:11: and the border will extend along the back of Ekron toward the north, and the borders will extend to Succoth, and the borders will pass on toward the south, and will extend to Lemna, and the outlet of the borders will be at the sea.
verses.15:12: And their borders on the sea side: the Great Sea will mark the border. These are the borders of the sons of Judah all around according to their clans.
verses.15:13: And to Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a portion in the midst of the sons of Judah by the command of God, and Joshua gave him the city of Arba, the mother city of Anak (this is Hebron).
verses.15:14: And Caleb the son of Jephunneh utterly destroyed from there the three sons of Anak, Sheshai and Talmai and Ahiman.
verses.15:15: And Caleb went up from there against the inhabitants of Debir; now the name of Debir formerly was City of Letters.
verses.15:16: And Caleb said, "Whoever takes and destroys the City of Letters and gains mastery over it, I will give him Achsah my daughter as a wife."
verses.15:17: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as a wife.
verses.15:18: And it came about, as she was going out, that she consulted with him, saying, "I will ask my father for a field." And she cried out from the donkey. And Caleb said to her, "What is the matter with you?"
verses.15:19: And she said to him, "Give me a blessing, because you have given me into the land of Negev; give me Boththanis." And he gave her upper Gonaithlan and lower Gonaithlan.
verses.15:20: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah.
verses.15:21: Now their cities were cities belonging to the tribe of the sons of Judah at the borders of Edom in the wilderness: Kaibaiseleel, and Ara, and Hazor,
verses.15:22: and Ikam, and Regma, and Aruel,
verses.15:23: and Kadesh, and Hasorionain, and Mainam,
verses.15:25: and the cities of Hezron (this is Hazor),
verses.15:26: and Sen, and Salmaa, and Moladah,
verses.15:28: and Cholaseola, and Beersheba, and their villages and their settlements;
verses.15:30: and Elboudad, and Bethel, and Hormah,
verses.15:31: and Ziklag, and Macharim, and Sethennak,
verses.15:32: and Labos, and Sale, and Eromoth; twenty-nine cities, and their villages.
verses.15:33: In the lowland: Eshtaol, and Raa, and Assa,
verses.15:34: and Ramen, and Tano, and Iluthoth, and Maiani,
verses.15:35: and Jarmuth, and Adullam, and Membra, and Socoh, and Jazeka,
verses.15:36: and Sakarim, and Gederah and its settlements, fourteen cities and their villages;
verses.15:38: and Dalal, and Mizpah, and Jakareel,
verses.15:39: and Maches, and Basedoth, and Ideadalea,
verses.15:40: and Chabra, and Maches, and Maachos,
verses.15:41: and Gedor, and Bagadiel, and Noman, and Makedan, sixteen cities and their villages;
verses.15:44: and Keilam, and Akiezi, and Kezib, and Bathesar, and Aijalon, ten cities and their villages;
verses.15:45: Ekron and its villages and their settlements;
verses.15:46: from Ekron, Gemna; and all that are near Ashdod, and their villages;
verses.15:47: Ashdod and its villages and its settlements; Gaza and its villages and its settlements as far as the brook of Egypt; and the Great Sea marks the border.
verses.15:48: And in the hill country: Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.15:49: and Renna, and City of Letters (this is Debir),
verses.15:50: and Anon, and Eskaiman, and Aisam,
verses.15:51: and Goshen, and Chalu, and Channa, eleven cities and their villages;
verses.15:53: and Jemain, and Beth-achu, and Phakua,
verses.15:54: and Heuma, and the city of Arba (this is Hebron), and Sorth, nine cities and their settlements;
verses.15:55: Maor, and Carmel, and Ozib, and Itan,
verses.15:56: and Jariel, and Jarikam, and Zakanaim,
verses.15:57: and Gibeah, and Timnah, nine cities and their villages;
verses.15:59: and Magaroth, and Beth-anam, and Thekum, six cities and their villages; Tekoa, and Ephrathah (this is Bethlehem), and Phagor, and Aitan, and Kulon, and Tatam, and Eobes, and Karem, and Galem, and Thether, and Manocho, eleven cities and their villages;
verses.15:60: Kiriath-baal (this is the city of Jearim), and Sotheba, two cities and their settlements;
verses.15:61: and Baddargis, and Tharabaam, and Ainon,
verses.15:62: and Aichioza, and Naphlazon, and the cities of Sadom, and Aknades, seven cities and their villages.
verses.15:63: And the Jebusite was living in Jerusalem, and the sons of Judah were not able to destroy them; and the Jebusites lived in Jerusalem until that day.
verses.16:1: And the borders of the sons of Joseph were from the Jordan opposite Jericho on the east, and they will go up from Jericho into the wilderness hill country to Bethel Luz,
verses.16:2: and they will go out to Bethel, and pass on to the borders of Chatarothi,
verses.16:3: and they will cross over toward the sea to the borders of Haptaleim as far as the borders of lower Beth-horon, and their termination will be at the sea.
verses.16:4: And the sons of Joseph, Ephraim and Manasseh, received an inheritance.
verses.16:5: And the borders of the sons of Ephraim were according to their clans; and the borders of their inheritance on the east were Astaroth and Erok as far as upper Beth-horon and Gezer.
verses.16:6: And the borders will go toward the sea to Hikasmon, on the north of Therma; they will go around toward the east to Thenasa and Sellesa, and pass on from the east to Janoah
verses.16:7: and to Macho and Astaroth, and their villages; and they will go to Jericho, and run out to the Jordan.
verses.16:8: And from Taphos the borders will proceed toward the sea to Chelkana, and their termination will be at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of Ephraim according to their clans.
verses.16:9: And the cities that were set apart for the sons of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities and their villages.
verses.16:10: And Ephraim did not destroy the Canaanite who lived in Gezer; and the Canaanite lived in Ephraim until this day, until Pharaoh king of Egypt went up and took it and burned it with fire, and they pierced through the Canaanites and the Perizzites and those who lived in Gezer; and Pharaoh gave it as a dowry to his daughter.
verses.17:1: And the borders of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh were, because he was the firstborn to Joseph, for Machir, the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead—for he was a man of war—in the region of Gilead and in the region of Bashan.
verses.17:2: And they were for the remaining sons of Manasseh according to their clans: for the sons of Jezei, and for the sons of Kelez, and for the sons of Jezeiel, and for the sons of Shechem, and for the sons of Symareim, and for the sons of Hepher. These are the males according to their clans.
verses.17:3: And as for Zelophehad son of Hepher, he had no sons, only daughters; and these are the names of the daughters of Zelophehad: Mahlah and Noah and Hoglah and Milcah and Tirzah.
verses.17:4: And they stood before Eleazar the priest and before Joshua and before the rulers, saying, "God commanded through the hand of Moses to give us an inheritance in the midst of our brothers." And a lot was given to them by the command of the Lord among the brothers of their father.
verses.17:5: And their measured portion fell from Anassa, and the plain of Labek from Gilead, which is beyond the Jordan;
verses.17:6: because the daughters of the sons of Manasseh inherited a lot in the midst of their brothers. And the land of Gilead belonged to the sons of Manasseh who were left.
verses.17:7: And the borders of the sons of Manasseh were Delanath, which is facing the sons of Anath, and they proceed to the borders, to Hiamein and Jasseib, to the spring of Thaphthoth.
verses.17:8: It will belong to Manasseh, and Thapheth on the borders of Manasseh to the sons of Ephraim.
verses.17:9: And the borders will go down to the ravine of Karana to the south, by the ravine of Jariel, a terebinth for Ephraim in the midst of a city of Manasseh; and the borders of Manasseh are on the north to the brook. And its termination will be the sea,
verses.17:10: on the south for Ephraim, and on the north for Manasseh; and the sea will be borders for them; and they will meet Jaseb on the north, and Issachar on the east.
verses.17:11: And Manasseh will have in Issachar and in Asher Kaithoan and their villages, and the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages, and the third part of Mapheta and its villages.
verses.17:12: And the sons of Manasseh were not able to utterly destroy these cities; and the Canaanite began to live in this land.
verses.17:13: And it happened that when the sons of Israel grew strong, they made the Canaanites subjects, but they did not utterly destroy them at all.
verses.17:14: Now the sons of Joseph spoke back to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given us one lot and one measured portion as an inheritance? Yet I am a numerous people, and God has blessed me."
verses.17:15: And Joshua said to them, "If you are a numerous people, go up into the forest and clear it for yourself, if the mountain of Ephraim is too narrow for you."
verses.17:16: And they said, "The mountain of Ephraim does not please us; and choice cavalry and iron belong to the Canaanite who lives in it, in Beth-shean and in its villages, in the valley of Israel."
verses.17:17: And Joshua said to the sons of Joseph, "If you are a numerous people and have great strength, you will not have one lot;
verses.17:18: for the forest will be yours, because it is a forest, and you will clear it, and it will be yours even when you utterly destroy the Canaanite, because he has choice cavalry; for you are stronger than he is."
verses.18:1: And the whole congregation of the sons of Israel was assembled at Shiloh, and they pitched the tent of testimony there, and the land was subdued by them.
verses.18:2: And the sons of Israel who had not received an inheritance were left, seven tribes.
verses.18:3: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "How long will you be slack in inheriting the land that the Lord our God has given?
verses.18:4: Give from among yourselves three men from each tribe, and let them rise up and go through the land, and map it out before me just as it will be necessary to go through it." And they came over to him,
verses.18:5: and he divided seven portions for them. Judah will stand as a border for them on the south, and the sons of Joseph will stand for them on the north.
verses.18:6: "Now you divide the land into seven portions and bring it to me here, and I will draw a lot for you before the Lord our God.
verses.18:7: For there is no portion for the sons of Levi among you, because the priesthood of the Lord is his portion; and Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh received their inheritance beyond the Jordan toward the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them."
verses.18:8: And the men rose up and went. And Joshua commanded the men who were going to survey the land, saying, "Go and survey the land, and come to me; and here I will draw a lot for you before the Lord in Shiloh."
verses.18:9: And they went and surveyed the land, and saw it, and wrote it down according to cities in seven portions in a book, and brought it to Joshua.
verses.18:10: And Joshua cast a lot for them in Shiloh before the Lord.
verses.18:11: And the lot of Benjamin came out first according to their clans; and the borders of their lot went out between Judah and the sons of Joseph.
verses.18:12: And their borders were on the north: from the Jordan the borders will go up along the back of Jericho on the north, and they will go up to the mountain toward the sea, and its termination will be Mabdareitis Baithon;
verses.18:13: and from there the borders will cross over to Luz, to the back of Luz on its south, that is, Bethel. And the borders will go down to Maatarothorech, to the hill country that is south of lower Beth-horon;
verses.18:14: and the borders will cross over and pass on to the mountain that looks along the sea on the south, from the mountain facing Beth-horon on the south, and its termination will be at Kiriath-baal, that is, Kiriath-jearim, a city of the sons of Judah; this is the side toward the sea.
verses.18:15: And the side toward the south is from the edge of Kiriath-baal; and the borders will cross over to Gasein, to the spring of water of Nephtoah;
verses.18:16: and the borders will go down to the edge, that is, facing the glen of Sonnam, which is on the edge of Emek-raphaein on the north; and they will go down to Gehenna, to the south of the Jebusite on the south; they will go down to the spring of Rogel;
verses.18:17: and they will cross over to the spring of Beth-shemesh, and pass on to Galiaoth, which is opposite toward the ascent of Aithamein, and go down to the stone of Baion of the sons of Reuben;
verses.18:18: and they will cross over along the back of Beth-arabah on the north, and go down to the borders, to the back of the sea on the north;
verses.18:19: and the termination of the borders will be at the crest of the Sea of Salt on the north, to the edge of the Jordan on the south. These are the borders on the south.
verses.18:20: And the Jordan will mark the border on the east side. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, its borders all around according to clans.
verses.18:21: And the cities of the sons of Benjamin according to their clans were Jericho, and Bethegaio, and Amekaseis,
verses.18:22: and Bethabara, and Sara, and Besana,
verses.18:23: and Aiein, and Parah, and Jephratha,
verses.18:24: and Karapha, and Chephirah, and Monei, and Geba—twelve cities and their villages;
verses.18:26: and Massema, and Meiron, and Hamoke,
verses.18:27: and Pheira, and Kaphan, and Nakan, and Selekan, and Taralah,
verses.18:28: and Jebus, that is, Jerusalem, and cities, and Gabaothiarim—thirteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their clans.
verses.19:1: And the second lot of the sons of Simeon came out, and their inheritance was in the midst of the lots of the sons of Judah.
verses.19:2: And their lot was Beersheba, Samaa, and Koladam,
verses.19:6: and Batharoth, and their fields: thirteen cities and their villages;
verses.19:7: Eremmon, Thalcha, Jether, and Ashan: four cities and their villages
verses.19:8: around their cities as far as Barek, going to Bameth toward the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their clans.
verses.19:9: From the lot of Judah was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, because the portion of the sons of Judah was greater than theirs; and the sons of Simeon inherited in the midst of their lot.
verses.19:10: And the third lot came out for Zebulun according to their clans. The borders of their inheritance will be Esedekgola; their borders
verses.19:11: will be the sea and Maragelda, and they will reach to Beth-arabah, to the ravine that is facing Jekman;
verses.19:12: and they turned back from Sedduk, opposite from the east of Beth-shemesh, to the borders of Chaselothaith, and they will pass on to Dabiroth, and will go up to Phangai;
verses.19:13: and from there they will go around opposite toward the east to Gebere, to the city of Katasem, and they will pass on to Remmona Hamathar Haoza;
verses.19:14: and the borders will go around to the north to Hamoth, and their end will be at Gaiphael,
verses.19:15: and Katanath, Nabaal, Symoon, Jericho, and Bethman.
verses.19:16: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun according to their clans, cities and their villages.
verses.19:17: And for Issachar the fourth lot came out.
verses.19:18: And their borders were Jazel, Chesulloth, and Shunem,
verses.19:19: and Hagin, Siona, Reeroth, and Anaharath,
verses.19:21: and Remmas, Ieon, Tomman, Aimarek, and Bersaphes.
verses.19:22: And the borders will reach to Gaithbor and to Salim toward the sea and Beth-shemesh; and the end of its borders will be the Jordan.
verses.19:23: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
verses.19:24: And the fifth lot came out for Asher.
verses.19:25: And their borders were from Heleketh, Haleph, Baithok, and Keaph,
verses.19:26: and Elimelech, Amiel, and Maasa; and they will reach Carmel toward the sea, and Seion and Labanath.
verses.19:27: And they will turn from the rising of the sun and Beth-egeneth, and they will reach Zebulun, and from Gai and Phthaiel on the north, and the borders will enter Saphthaibethme and Inael, and will pass on to Chobamasomel,
verses.19:28: and Elbon, Raab, Ememaon, and Kanthan as far as great Sidon;
verses.19:29: and the borders will turn back to Ramah and as far as the spring of Masphassat and of the Tyrians; and the borders will turn back to Iasiph, and its end will be the sea, and from Leb and Echozob,
verses.19:31: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their clans, cities and their villages.
verses.19:32: And for Naphtali the sixth lot came out.
verses.19:33: And their borders were Moolam, Mola, Besemiin, Arme, Nabok, and Jephthamai as far as Dodam; and its ends were the Jordan.
verses.19:34: And the borders turn toward the sea to Enath-tabor, and from there they will pass on to Hiakana, and they will reach Zebulun on the south, and they will reach Asher toward the sea, and the Jordan from the rising of the sun.
verses.19:35: And the fortified cities of the Tyrians: Tyre, Homatha, Daketh, and Chinnereth;
verses.19:37: and Kedesh, Assarei, and the spring of Hazor,
verses.19:38: and Keroe, Megala, Harim, Beth-thame, and Thessamys.
verses.19:39: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali.
verses.19:40: And for Dan the seventh lot came out.
verses.19:41: And their borders were Sarath and Asa, cities of Sammaus,
verses.19:46: and from the sea, Jerakon, a border near Joppa.
verses.19:47: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their clans, their cities and their villages. And the sons of Dan did not drive out the Amorite who was pressing them in the hill country; and the Amorites would not allow them to go down into the valley, and they pressed back from them the border of their portion.
verses.19:48: And the sons of Judah went and fought against Lachish, and captured it and struck it with the edge of the sword, and settled in it and called its name Lasenndak. And the Amorite persisted in living in Elom and in Salamin; and the hand of Ephraim grew heavy upon them, and they came under tribute to them.
verses.19:49: And they went to take possession of the land according to their border. And the sons of Israel gave a lot to Joshua the son of Nun among them
verses.19:50: by the command of God; and they gave him the city that he asked for, Thamarchares, which is in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city and lived in it.
verses.19:51: These are the divisions which Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the leaders of the ancestral houses in the tribes of Israel apportioned as an inheritance by lots in Shiloh before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and they went to take possession of the land.
verses.20:1: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.20:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'Give the cities of refuge about which I spoke to you through Moses,
verses.20:3: a refuge for the killer who struck a person unintentionally; and the cities will be a refuge for you, and the killer will not be put to death by the avenger of blood until he stands before the assembly for judgment.'"
verses.20:7: And he set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and the city of Arba, that is, Hebron, in the hill country of Judah.
